name: Attack Boost
description: Increases a creature’s damage output for a turn or specific move, ideal for setting up big finishing hits.

name: Defense
description: Raises armor, barriers, or shields to reduce incoming damage and keep key creatures alive longer.

name: Speed Boost
description: Improves turn order and responsiveness so your creatures can act before opponents or take extra moves.

name: Healing
description: Restores health instantly or over time, recovering from chip damage or stabilizing after heavy hits.

name: Amplifier
description: Multiplies or enhances existing elemental effects, turning ordinary attacks into huge swings.

name: Element Shift
description: Temporarily changes an attack’s element to exploit weaknesses or bypass specific resistances.

name: Status
description: Applies stuns, slows, burns, freezes, or other debuffs that limit enemy options and tempo.

name: Cleanse
description: Removes negative effects and battlefield hazards from your side to reset the board state.

name: Draw
description: Improves card access by drawing or filtering, helping you find key powers and combo pieces.

name: Copy
description: Replays or duplicates recent actions so you can reuse your strongest moves at the perfect time.

name: Ultimate Charge
description: Builds toward extremely strong, high-cost abilities that can swing or decide entire games.

name: Utility
description: Flexible tools that bend rules, move pieces, scout, or otherwise don’t fit neatly into other categories.
